record.hypothesis: For all four datasets, replace the pairwise loss with margin-one logistic ranking loss: softplus(1-(positive_score-negative_score)), averaged over the same valid target positions. Requiring greater positive-negative separation may improve top-10 discrimination without changing sampled pairs or adding another scorer. Preserve embeddings, HSTU architecture, cumulative positions, scoring/readout, optimizer, sampling and training schedule. Retain exactly one trained checkpoint per category.
